author: Gamma, Helm, Johnson, Vlissides (Gang of Four)
note: Source PDF is image-based and not text-extractable; rules derived from the established content of this work.

principles.rule: Program to an interface, not an implementation. Depend on abstract types, not concrete classes.
checks: public APIs expressed via interfaces/abstract types
no construction of concretes in business logic

principles.rule: Favor object composition over class inheritance. Use inheritance only for true is-a relationships honoring LSP.
Encapsulate what varies: isolate the parts likely to change behind a stable interface (e.g. Strategy, Factory, Bridge).
checks: varying algorithms behind a strategy interface
no type-switch branching to select behavior

principles.rule: Use established pattern names as shared vocabulary; name the pattern in code/comments when one is applied intentionally.
checks: pattern intent is clear from naming

principles.rule: Apply patterns only when the problem genuinely calls for them; avoid speculative pattern-driven overengineering.
checks: pattern introduced to solve a present variability/complexity, not speculatively

principles.rule: Avoid Singleton/global mutable state for testability; prefer dependency injection of collaborators.
checks: dependencies injected, not fetched from globals
no hidden singletons in core logic
